resources.string: Curfew reads the name of the app in the foreground so it can close the ones you have chosen to block. While a lock is running it also checks whether the screen in front is the Curfew settings or uninstall page, so it can hold that page shut; that is the only time it looks at what is on screen, and it looks only for its own name. Nothing it sees is stored, and nothing leaves your device.
Shows while a session is running, so you always know when Curfew is enforcing something.
Shows whether Curfew is blocking anything, and how many days in a row you have kept.
